# Incident Report: Overnight Refrigeration Failure at Rosewood Bakery

**Report ID:** RB-2024-017
**Date of Incident:** March 14, 2024
**Prepared by:** Operations Review Team, Rosewood Bakery
**Distribution:** Ownership, Management, All Staff (summary version)

---

## 1. Summary

At approximately 11:40 p.m. on March 13, 2024, the walk-in cooler at Rosewood Bakery experienced a compressor failure during a scheduled defrost cycle. The failure went undetected until 4:15 a.m. on March 14, when the opening baker arrived and found the cooler interior at 52°F (11°C), well above the safe holding temperature of 41°F (5°C) or below. All temperature-sensitive inventory was discarded. No products reached customers, and no illness resulted. The bakery lost an estimated $3,400 in ingredients and prepared goods and delayed opening by two hours.

This report reconstructs the incident timeline, examines contributing factors, and recommends corrective measures. Our analysis focuses on systemic conditions rather than individual error, consistent with our commitment to a just culture in which staff can report problems without fear of blame.
